read.title: Weekly Ad Review – Collagen Mask
read.text:
Ad sales for the collagen mask reached $8,400 this week, up 12% compared to last week. However, ACoS rose from 24% to 31% because several broad keywords spent a lot without converting.

The click-through rate on our main campaign stayed at 0.6%, which is below the category average. I'd suggest that we lower the bid on the five weakest keywords and test a new main image next week.

We will review the results again next Friday.

write.en: Write a short update to your manager on this week's Amazon ad results, with one change from last week and one suggestion for next week.
write.model:
Hi Jiwon,

Here is this week's ad update. Ad sales were $5,200, up 9% compared to last week, but ACoS increased to 28%. Most of the extra spend came from two broad keywords. I'd suggest that we lower the bid on those keywords and add three exact-match keywords next week.

Thanks,
Minsu
